message: Astra: In your latest notebook revision, the sentence introducing what she records still ends with an ellipsis; does that leave the promised content unwritten rather than clarify it? Within this scene, what deserves attention before you can choose her recorded content? Would more thinking resolve that uncertainty, or would an informative draft reveal more? Conversely, what uncertainty makes drafting premature? What evidence would justify either choice, and could you carry out your chosen next step rather than announce another future revision?
speaker: Astra
